content.text:
Micron, Sandisk, Apple, ON Semiconductor, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
Tech stocks looked set to extend a recent slump on Friday as shares of chip makers broadly declined. Wall Street appeared to be spooked by what Apple decision to raise prices means for memory demand along with a report that ChatGPT developer OpenAI could delay its initial public offering.
